title: Story order
info: A simple story has a beginning, a middle, and an ending.
The beginning shows who and where. The middle brings a problem. The ending shows how things finish.

questions.q: The beginning of a story usually tells
options: who is there and where they are
introduce a brand-new hero and stop
be shuffled so nobody can tell

questions.q: A story about a lost cat starts best with
options: the cat at home before it slips out
the cat already found, with no setup

questions.q: Type the part that comes first: beginning, middle, or ending.
